reasons.plausibility: The notion that an in-situ oxide layer can reduce metal-to-metal contact and enhance wear resistance aligns well with established tribological principles for high-temperature alloy systems.
reasons.testability: Comparing wear and friction behavior in oxidizing versus inert environments is a direct, straightforward test that can decisively confirm or refute the role of the oxide film.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a clear mechanistic pathway to investigate an important protective mechanism for HEA coatings and outlines an unambiguous experiment that can guide further development.
